column1: # Cancer types (TCGA cohorts) appearing in the NeST hierarchy.
# Source of the code list: "NeST Map - Main Model.cx2" / NeST_hierarchy_HCX.cx2 —
# the 13 `Mutation frequency:<CODE>` node attributes, identical to the set of codes
#   code            cohort code exactly as it appears in the CX2 attribute names
#   cohort_name     official TCGA study name (provenance/label only; not used for matching)
#   search_terms    pipe-separated disease labels to look up in MONDO, most preferred first.
#                   Curated: a TCGA study name is often not a MONDO label (e.g. "Kidney Renal
#                   Clear Cell Carcinoma" vs "clear cell renal carcinoma").
#   override_mondo  curator-pinned MONDO id; skips lookup, but the term is still fetched and
#                   validated (must exist, must not be obsolete). Use only where the automatic
#                   anchors disagree with the intended cohort — always give a reason.
#   override_reason free text, required when override_mondo is set
